title: Vista Config
description: Configuration file for Vista — a TUI log aggregator for multiple services.

profiles.description: List of named profiles. Run `vista <name>` to select one; bare `vista` uses the profile marked "default": true, or the first profile if none is marked.

name.description: Profile identifier used on the CLI. The name "init" is reserved.

default.description: If true, this profile is used when no name is passed to the CLI. Only one profile should be marked as default.

services.description: Services to manage in this profile.

name.description: Display name shown in the sidebar. Must be unique within the profile.

cmd.description: Shell command to run (executed via sh -c). Supports pipes, loops, and other shell syntax.

dir.description: Working directory for the command. Supports ~ expansion. Defaults to the current directory if omitted.

envFile.description: Path to a .env file to load. Supports ~ expansion. If omitted, Vista auto-loads .env from dir if one exists.

globalViews.description: Named views that interleave logs from multiple services.

name.description: Display name shown in the sidebar (prefixed with ⊞).

services.description: Service names to include. An empty array enables all services.
